test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Five persons S, T, U, V, and W are standing in a line facing towards the east. Only T is standing between U and S. U is standing third to the right of W and to the immediate left of V. 

Who is standing at the extreme right end?
solution: **Five person: **S, T, U, V, and W are standing in a line facing towards the east. 1) U is standing third to the right of W and to the immediate left V.
